mentions.note: New CEO John Riley (ex-SeaWorld) offers turnaround credibility; Jana Partners activist backing; balance sheet 6.3x leverage still precarious; requires patience on execution; don't commit capital unless willing to hold through 2-3 year turnaround.
Caller asked about post-merger with property sales for kids' portfolio. Cramer: too dicey; don't want to sour kids on stocks; many better REIT alternatives available; too much risk and debt concerns.
